metadata.short_desc: Search manager: division of labor, fallback, spending caps and call log
metadata.desc: Lets DeepSeek search, AstrBot's built-in web search and community search plugins work together by specialty: general search plus specialists for images, videos, papers, GitHub and more. DeepSeek first with automatic fallback on outages or spending caps, per-tool usage stats, a call log for all tools and a dashboard.

api_key.hint: Leave empty to reuse the key of an existing DeepSeek provider (api_base on api.deepseek.com).

labels: Pause DeepSeek, use other search tools
routing_mode.hint: "Guide only" keeps every tool and states priorities in the guide, so the tool list never changes and prompt caching is never invalidated. "DeepSeek first" hides overlapping tools while DeepSeek works; each switch invalidates the cache once.

fallback_tool_patterns.hint: Tool names matching these patterns (* wildcard) are hidden while DeepSeek works and shown when it doesn't.

include_content.description: Include page content in search results

record_queries.description: Show recent queries in the dashboard

call_log_enabled.hint: Records calls of all tools, not only DeepSeek, in calls.db under the plugin data directory.

call_log_record_other_content.description: Record full args and results of other tools
call_log_record_other_content.hint: By default only name, source, duration and status are kept for other tools.

billing_currency.hint: Match your DeepSeek account. Costs and spending caps use this currency.

daily_budget.hint: In the billing currency. 0 means unlimited.

monthly_budget.hint: In the billing currency, calendar month. 0 means unlimited.

exchange_rate.hint: Only used to show costs in the other currency.

specialist_rules.hint: One per line: "tool pattern = what it is good at" (* wildcard). Matching tools are kept as specialists and described to the model.

inject_search_guide.description: Tell the model which search tool does what
inject_search_guide.hint: Appends a short, stable guide listing only the tools available in the request.

dashboard.title: DeepDeep Dashboard
dashboard.description: Spending and usage, per-tool search stats, routing and specialist settings, call log.
